info.title: Tidefern API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for every Tidefern client. Health data travels only in request and response bodies, never in paths or query strings.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

profile.description: The profile summary, or null until onboarding creates the profile

guardianOf.description: Children this actor is a guardian of

grants.description: Active grants where this actor is the grantee

authenticatedAt.description: When this session was created by signing in

timeZone.description: IANA time zone every calendar fact is read in

childId.description: The one child a child grant reaches

authorId.description: Who wrote it; null once the author's account is gone

category.description: Where the note is filed, which decides who may ever read it

date.description: Calendar date in the subject's time zone

body.description: Decrypted for the owner and a read or contribute grantee; absent for a summary grantee and on a tombstone

version.description: Sent back as If-Match on an update

deletedAt.description: Set on a tombstone in a sync list; the row holds nothing else

Note.description: A note as the signed-in actor may see it.

id.description: Optional client-minted UUIDv7 for offline-first clients

subject.description: Whose note this is: the signed-in person when absent. Another person's id needs a contribute grant from them in the category given.

date.description: Calendar date in the subject's time zone

category.description: Your own notes always start in journal.private; the share action re-files one. A note about another person is filed under the category their grant covers.

body.description: Free text; encrypted at rest with the subject's data key, never logged

NoteCreateInput.description: A new note. The body is the only free text.

nextCursor.description: Opaque; pass back as cursor for the next page

NoteList.description: One page of notes in date order.

date.description: Calendar date in the subject's time zone

body.description: Free text; encrypted at rest with the subject's data key, never logged

NoteUpdateInput.description: Changes to a note's date or body. The category changes only through the share action.

NoteShareInput.description: Re-files the note under a shareable category.

NoteShareCategory.description: A shareable category the note is re-filed into. The private journal is never granted.

get.description: The actor id, the profile summary, guardianships, active grants held and the session expiry: every client bootstraps from this one call.

type.description: A stable URN that identifies the problem type; it never depends on a domain

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. forbidden is used only for origin and cross-site failures; denied access is not_found.

errors.description: Field level validation errors when applicable

post.description: A new note about the signed-in person, filed in the private journal, or about a person who granted contribute access, filed under that grant's category. The body is encrypted with the subject's data key. Requires Idempotency-Key.
